description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling direct message (DM) access control, authorization, and message dispatching within a plugin SDK. It includes policy resolution, authorization callbacks, and message routing for direct DMs.

methods.name: resolveInboundDirectDmAccessWithRuntime
methods.description: Resolves direct DM access permissions, including policy, allowlists, and command authorization, based on runtime configuration and sender info.

methods.name: createPreCryptoDirectDmAuthorizer
methods.description: Creates an authorization callback for pre-crypto direct DMs, handling allow, block, and pairing decisions.

methods.name: createDirectDmPreCryptoGuardPolicy
methods.description: Generates a shared policy object for DM pre-crypto guardrails with customizable overrides.

methods.name: dispatchInboundDirectDmWithRuntime
methods.description: Routes, envelopes, records, and dispatches a single direct DM message through the standard pipeline, handling context and session management.
